subjects.name: MOTT'S MARKER
LOOK_AT: A marker for Obadiah Mott, erected by public subscription in the fifth year. Well kept. Flowers, even.
The flowers are wax. The undertaker's lilies, on loan for the look of the thing.
It is the best-kept grave on the hill, for a man nobody here ever buried.
LISTEN_TO: Wind across the stone. It has a lot of town to cover and it starts here.

subjects.name: PIKE'S NEIGHBOR
LOOK_AT: A grave, open, waiting, with my name on the marker. Frame has spelled it wrong.
The spade is still in the spoil heap, waiting for a decision that has already been made.
Frame's spelling is on the marker in paint. The undertaker has left room to correct it, and will not.
LISTEN_TO: A trickle of dirt into the bottom of it. Practice.
Nothing yet, for the second time. The yet is doing a great deal of work.

LOOK_AT: My plot, my headboard, HE TUNED. I visit. It is restful, in the way of problems that have been filed.
The grass has started over it. I am the first man in Consolation to watch his own grave come in.
Someone has left a tuning peg on the headboard, a piano's. I know whose piano. I am not going to say.
LISTEN_TO: Wind in the oats. My grave is the only one here whose tenant can review the accommodations, and I give it high marks.
Nothing. Not from me, and I would know.
The oats again, and somewhere down the hill, a piano, in tune.

subjects.name: THE NINETEEN
LOOK_AT: AMOS TREADWELL. BLACKSMITH. 1850.
JOSIAH PENHALLOW. MINER, OF CORNWALL. 1851.
ELIAS CRANE. SURVEYOR. 1850.
RAFAEL SANDOVAL. MULETEER. 1852.
SILAS MARCHBANK. CLERK. 1851.
PATRICK KEANE. CARPENTER. 1853.
ABEL STROUD. GAMBLER. 1854.
ISAAC PELL. WHEELWRIGHT. 1855.
OWEN PROTHERO. COLLIER, OF GLAMORGAN. 1857.
The row ends. Nine names, nine trades, nine dates, and the same grass over all of them.

subjects.name: PIKE'S MARKER
LOOK_AT: Ezra Pike. The man I was sent to find. Six years.
A plain board, kept upright. The undertaker's work, and paid for, I would guess, by the undertaker.
I have his letter of introduction in my coat. It introduces me to this.
LISTEN_TO: Nothing. I have come a very long way to hear it.
Nothing, still. He was never going to answer, and I keep asking anyway.
Wind in the grass over him, and that is all the reply there is.

overrides.TALK_TO: I read him my letter of introduction. It seemed only right. He took it as well as anything else I've said here.
overrides.USE: It is in use. That is the entire and only thing a plot can be.

THE GATE.CLOSE: It swings back. The latch is broken in the direction of welcome, which is not the direction you want a graveyard broken in.
